response.sql: WITH t AS (SELECT COALESCE(TRIM(p.throws), '') AS hand, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM player_award pa JOIN player p ON pa.player_id = p.player_id GROUP BY COALESCE(TRIM(p.throws), '')), s AS (SELECT hand, cnt, 1.0 * cnt / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM t) AS share FROM t), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT SUM(s.cnt) AS total_tally, AVG(s.share) AS avg_share, AVG(s.share - a.avg_share) AS avg_excess FROM s, a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share
